card.name: Medieval kings and princes in history
card.fires_on: Words in historical texts about European monarchs, such as king, prince, saintly, Serbian or granted, in biographies of medieval rulers and courts.

modes.description: Words tied to a medieval court, state or law, such as Serbian, granted, assistant or Vladimir.

card.writes: It pushes toward the word Royal and similar terms, and away from the word English in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires on words about kings, princes and royal courts in history passages.
